name: Sisters of Stone Death
description: Five gorgons who overthrew Svogthir and sealed him in a tomb.

description_citations.text: "Svogthir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Sisters of Stone Death attempt to overthrow Svogthir; they succeed and keep him under arrest in a tomb in Grigor Canyon.
timeline.quote: Less than a millennium before the Decamillennial, the Sisters of Stone Death , originally a quintet of gorgons , attempted to overthrow parun Svogthir.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra, helped by Szadek, takes control of the guild, resurrects Svogthir to overthrow the Sisters, and proclaims herself guildmaster.
timeline.quote: After this, Savra proclaimed herself as the new Golgari guildmaster.

citation.text: "Golgari Swarm", section "Ravnica block". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Svogthir and the Golgari reduce the Sisters of Stone Death to only Ludmilla.
timeline.quote: the Sisters of Stone Death were diminished to only one: Ludmilla

citation.text: "Gorgon", section "Ravnica". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The five gorgons known as the Sisters of Stone Death overthrow Svogthir; he kills two, but the others rot his body and seal him in the tomb Svogthos.
timeline.quote: Svogthir was overthrown by five gorgons

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Rise and fall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Guildpact's Decamillennial anniversary, Savra frees Svogthir and builds him a new body, which he uses to defeat the Sisters, killing two more.
timeline.quote: She freed Svogthir from his tomb and constructed a new body for him

citation.text: "Svogthir", section "Reappearance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: Originally a quintet of gorgons who overthrew Svogthir and ruled the Swarm until Savra's takeover.
